title: LIS3DH
text: Measure linear acceleration, voltage, and temperature from LIS3DH sensor, 14 outputs, {Detect} sets Select interrupt Inertial; {I2C Module} sets the specific module used for I2C communication, {I2C address}, {Acceleration (m/s 2 )} sets the output port for reading acceleration, {ADC3 input} selects output port for reading temperature, {Voltage (external input at ADC1)} selects output port for reading voltage, {Voltage (external input at ADC2)} selects output port for reading voltage, {Acceleration data ready status} sets the output port for obtaining acceleration, {Accelerometer resolution} sets the data register bit, {Accelerometer output data rate (Hz)} sets the rate at which accelerometer data is sampled, {Accelerometer range} sets the full scale for measuring linear acceleration, {Enable FIFO} enables number of samples to read, {Number of samples to read from FIFO (1-32)}, {Generate FIFO overrun interrupt on INT1 pin} sets the generate interrupt when FIFO buffer, {Enable high pass filter}, {HPF cutoff frequency (Hz)} sets the bandwidth of high pass filter, {Generate data ready interrupt on INT1 pin} sets the generate interrupt when data is ready, {Data type} sets the output data type for values from lis3dh sensor, {Sample time} sets the time interval to read data, {Enable click detection} sets the option for enabling click detection, {Type} selects type of click to be detected Single, {Threshold (m/s 2 )} sets the threshold for detecting single or double, {Time limit (s)} sets the time limit duration, {Time latency (s)} sets the time latency duration, {Time window (s)} sets the time window duration, {X axis}, {Y axis}, {Z axis}, {Generate click interrupt} sets the generate interrupt when click is detected, {Interrupt pin} sets the pin to generate click, {Click status} sets the output port for obtaining click detection, {Configurable detections} sets the number of configurable detections, {-X axis}, {-Y axis}, {-Z axis}, {Threshold (m/s 2} sets the acceleration threshold for detecting the selected configurable, {Duration (s)} sets the time limit duration and {Generate interrupt}. Values come from the instance.
